reason: VALUE lens: the gain claimed for part (a) does not hold up, part (b) is correct but is only bookkeeping. (a) 1) Size of the loss it guards: the insertion is worth ~+0.001 LB (#35-#34, one probe, 3-decimal display). The worst-case step-0 margin is 28,800-28,071 = 729 s, and that anchor is an UPPER bound (L35 includes queue time; N<=97 is an upper bound). A rider adding 12 s/clip of tail adds ~1,164 s, so ~435 s go past the 8.0 h gate. That is ~3-4 of 97 clips without insertion, 0.04 x 0.001 = ~4e-5. The claimed -0.0002..-0.0005 would need 20-50% of the clips past the gate (2,700-6,900 s over), a grossly slow world that the build's own latency shows before the 29 Sep selection, because public and private are scored from ONE run. EV = P(fire | upper-bound anchor, ~0.03-0.1) x 1e-5..1e-4, about 1e-6..1e-5. The attribution confound is capped by the same ~4e-5, far below the 0.001 LB display step. 2) The GPU half of the gate sits inside session noise. The six dummies share identical GPU code (lowrefine is post-GPU), yet per-clip 'detection+edges' means are exp56 244.1, FF 223.8, K1 218.9, K2 218.7, exp57b 216.5, FD 215.1 s. exp56 is +25.4 s/clip vs K2 with zero GPU change, so the 15 s/clip-shard threshold would FAIL about 1 dummy in 5 by noise. It needs a same-session or ratio comparison. The repair half is fine: identical-code repair differs by ~2 s/clip (exp57b 122.9 vs K1 125.0; exp56 56.6 vs FF 54.8), so an 8 s threshold is above noise. 3) The fixed 8 s / 15 s thresholds throw away the real anchor. L(K2) will be observed ~07-08 UTC 26 Sep, before any rider slot (K3 S4 ~10-13 UTC). The allowance is (28,800 - L(K2))/N per clip: if L(K2) <= 7.3 h that is >= 26 s/clip, and the fixed gate would force needless rebuilds. 4) The remedy (DIVINS_DEADLINE_S 32,400) rewrites a pre-registered constant, which needs the user's explicit OK (H1 feasibility (4)). Per the D4 value verdict (d), a later insertion gate adds 66-185 s/clip for the ~28 clips between 8 and 9 h (~0.5 h). In the slow world it insures, that can push clips past the 9.5 h repair deadline, where relink/readmit/gapfill are worth more than insertion. (a) is also the runtime-ledger half already adopted in the D4 and H1 fixes, with worse thresholds. (b) holds on transfer: the dummies are train copies (CONTEXT l.21), in-sample for detector, edge net and head. FD's +0.0069 is one clip (44b6_0113de3b +0.093/4 = +0.023; the other clips net negative). The LB has already overturned this pattern twice: probe 21, relink OFF, was +0.0053 locally and -0.002 on LB; probe 29, edge filter, was +0.016 in the lab and 0 on LB. Readmit is what took x138 from 0.947 to 0.953. Recording it costs nothing, and it is already in lens_redteam-plan.notes.md l.14. It is not a closed line in disguise and not a node-count artefact, but its value is ~0 and it rests on overstated numbers.
fix: Do not add the fixed-threshold gate or the automatic DIVINS 9.0 h rebuild. Instead: (1) Add one line to CONTEXT now recording the FD trap: FD 0.9249 vs K1 0.9180 is in-sample, from train-copy dummies, and one clip is +0.023 of it; probes 21/29 show this pattern gives 0 or a loss on LB; never act on it. (2) Merge (a) into the H1 runtime ledger, anchored on the OBSERVED L(K2). For each rider, dummy_gates.py prints the per-clip repair delta vs K1/K2, which is a hard input (noise ~2 s/clip). It prints the GPU 'detection+edges' delta only as a ratio to a same-session twin, or as the median of 2 dummies, and marks it INFO rather than FAIL (identical-code session offsets reach +25 s/clip). Forecast F = L(K2) + N_max x (delta_repair + delta_gpu/2) x 1.15, with N_max = 97. Flag only if F > 7.9 h. Then ask the user before touching DIVINS_DEADLINE_S, and only raise it if F + (clips between 8.0 h and the new gate) x 66-185 s stays < 9.0 h, so the 9.5 h repair deadline cannot be reached. (3) Keep the SAFETAIL log-line check (the deadlines in probe.json appear in the 'SAFETAIL:' line). It is free and catches wrong builds.
realistic_gain: About 0. Part (a) EV ~1e-6..1e-5 on private (= public, same run), and 0 in every world where the rider build's latency is <= 8.0 h, which covers all runs observed so far (L34 <= 6.46 h, L35 <= 7.73 h). Its GPU threshold would false-fire on ~1 of 5 dummies. Part (b) avoids a false lead worth -0.002..0 if someone acted on FD. Cost: 0.2 h for the CONTEXT line plus the ledger printout. No LB slot, no GPU.
